jobs.title: Data submission
jobs.description: Submit catch and effort records for checking.

jobs.title: Quality check
jobs.description: Check records and return invalid effort for correction.

jobs.title: Prepare and load
jobs.description: Store the accepted records in a fixed database snapshot.

jobs.title: Extract data
jobs.description: Use saved SQL to select observations and annual catches.

jobs.title: CPUE analysis A
jobs.description: Fit a CPUE index with year and vessel effects.

jobs.title: CPUE analysis B
jobs.description: Fit an alternative index with year effects only.

jobs.title: Compare CPUE results
jobs.description: Compare both indices in a plot and table.

jobs.title: CPUE report
jobs.description: Write a short account of the CPUE methods and results.

jobs.title: Prepare inputs A
jobs.description: Join index A to annual catches and check the model inputs.

jobs.title: Prepare inputs B
jobs.description: Join index B to annual catches and check the model inputs.

jobs.title: Assessment A1
jobs.description: Fit the illustrative model to index A with growth-rate setting 1.

jobs.title: Assessment A2
jobs.description: Fit the illustrative model to index A with growth-rate setting 2.

jobs.title: Assessment B1
jobs.description: Fit the illustrative model to index B with growth-rate setting 1.

jobs.title: Assessment B2
jobs.description: Fit the illustrative model to index B with growth-rate setting 2.

jobs.title: Compare assessments
jobs.description: Compare the four fitted cases in plots and tables.

jobs.title: Assessment report
jobs.description: Write a short report and preserve its analytical record.

jobs.title: Prepare MSE
jobs.description: Use the four assessment cases to prepare stocks for simulated management trials.

jobs.title: Constant catch
jobs.description: Test a fixed annual catch under the same simulated future conditions.

jobs.title: Index rule
jobs.description: Update annual catch using a simulated abundance index.

jobs.title: Buffered rule
jobs.description: Set catch from index thresholds and the selected buffer; limit annual advice changes to 15%.

jobs.title: MSE results summary
jobs.description: Compare catch, stock levels and catch stability across the management trials.

jobs.title: MSE report
jobs.description: Report the tested procedures, their trade-offs and the limits of the example.
